settings.language.title: Settings: label of the Language picker.
settings.language.system: Settings > Language: the first option, follow the device's language.
chat.code.copy: Chat, code block head line: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the code).
chat.table.copy: Full screen table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the table as Markdown text).
chat.copied: Chat and full screen views: accessibility label the copy icon takes for 1.5 s after copying, shown as a checkmark (status, past participle: the text was copied).
chat.table.expand: Chat, above a wide table: accessibility label and tooltip of the expand icon button that opens the table full screen (action; noun phrase is fine).
viewer.close: Full screen code or table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the close icon button (verb, command).
viewer.wrap: Full screen code view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of a toggle icon; on, long lines wrap; off, they scroll sideways (verb phrase, command).
viewer.code: Full screen code view: its name for screen readers when the code block names no language (noun: program code).
viewer.table: Full screen table view: its name for screen readers (noun: a data table).
